title: Flying
wikitext:
'''Flying''' is an inherent property held by certain entities and cannot be acquired by the player.

==Mechanics==

Flying entities can freely move over gaps, ledges, and other non-traversable terrain, as well as small obstacles like rocks and prison bars which typically block movement.<ref>{{cite web|author=Chris|date=January 30, 2014|title=1.0.6 Patch Notes and Flying Monsters|url=https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/777516/page/1#p6740821|publisher=Official Path of Exile Forums|accessdate=January 30, 2014}}</ref> Flying entities cannot go through solid walls, {{il|Frost Wall}}, or other extreme vertical terrain differences, however.

Flying entities ignore many [[ground effects]].<ref>{{cite web|author=Chris|date=January 30, 2014|title=1.0.6 Patch Notes and Flying Monsters|url=https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/777516/page/1#p6740821|publisher=Official Path of Exile Forums|accessdate=January 30, 2014}}</ref> However, they are still affected by {{stl|Consecrated Ground}} and {{stl|Desecrated Ground}}. Other arena-specific effects will vary on a case-by-case basis.

Flying entities do not block the movement of non-flying entities.<ref>{{cite web|author=Chris|date=January 30, 2014|title=1.0.6 Patch Notes and Flying Monsters|url=https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/777516/page/1#p6740821|publisher=Official Path of Exile Forums|accessdate=January 30, 2014}}</ref>

==List of flying entities==
===Minions===
* {{il|Animate Weapon}}
* {{il|Summon Raging Spirit}}
* {{il|Summon Holy Relic}}

===Enemies===
* Raging Spirit enemies ({{il|Shore Map}}, {{il|Death and Taxes}}, [[Delve]])
* Certain Animated Weapon enemies{{confirm}}
** [[The Steel Soul]] and Animated Weapons from the boss arena of {{il|Arsenal Map}} are not considered flying.
